note: Franklin County, IN (18047) publishes its zoning only as a scanned PDF zone map (Section 80.04, kept in the Area Plan Commission office). The county GIS Map FeatureServer (services2.arcgis.com/Y0fDSibEfxdu2Ya6) has parcels, floodplains, wetlands and utilities but no zoning layer. The wthgis web viewer exposes no REST services. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Franklin County zoning found nothing for the county. Brookville, Oldenburg and other towns in the county show no published zoning GIS either (only third-party Zoneomics pages and the Brookville municipal code). Johnson County's 'Franklin Zoning' layer covers the City of Franklin, not this county.
